pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Exchange Variation, Bronstein Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an impossible f4-g4 route; plan 3 routed Nd2-f1-e3 (the f1-rook is there), replaced with the standard Nbd2-c4 or Na3-c4 against the d6-queen; plan 2 now notes queenside castling. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Gligoric, 6.d4 Bg4 7.c3 Bd6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Nbd2-f1-e3 with the rook on f1. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Gligoric, 6.d4 Bg4 7.dxe5
pages.notes: Overview said White has the worse structure (it has the better one); plan 1 had an impossible f4-g4-h4 route. Rewritten around 7...Qxd1 8.Rxd1 fxe5. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Gligoric, 6.d4 Bg4 Queenswap, 9.Rd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4 onto Black's bishop; plan 2 had an impossible ...c5-b5-a5 passed pawn; plan 4 called the f8-bishop light-squared. Fixed. Plan 3 (Rg3, blocked by the f3-knight) restored: the Rb3 rewrite was rejected as unconfirmed; the reviewer suggests the main line is Nbd2-c4 with the rook staying on the d-file. (Not a flagged reference, so no skip entry.)

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Gligoric, 6.d4 Bg4 Queenswap, 9.Rd3 Bd6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4 onto Black's bishop and sent a knight to c5 and e3; plan 2 called the f-file open (it is half-open). Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Gligoric, 6.d4 exd4 7.Nxd4 c5
pages.notes: Overview claimed a central pawn mass and plan 2 a ...d5 break, but Black has no d-pawn. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Bird's Defense Deferred
pages.notes: Overview called the line sharp and tactical (it is slow, per the brief); plan 1 had the d4-knight take the a4-bishop (impossible); plan 4 pushed d2-d4 onto the knight. Rewritten around 5.Nxd4 exd4 6.O-O Bc5. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...b5 with the bishop on b5 and a bishop pair White doesn't have. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Alapin's Defense Deferred
pages.notes: Overview said 4...Bb4 challenges the a4-bishop (it doesn't); plan 2 took on c3 with nothing there. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Classical Defense Deferred
pages.notes: Overview called the c5-bishop light-squared; plan 3 had a nonsense Nf3-g3-f1-e3 route. Fixed. British spelling.
